name: Maricao (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green field crossed from hoist to fly by a yellow zigzag band with three points, for the mountains of the region.
history: Maricao is a town and municipality at the western edge of the Cordillera Central of Puerto Rico. The flag derives its colours, design and symbolism from the municipal shield: the green for the vegetation and the yellow band for the mountains.

features.role: zigzag band with three points, for the mountains
